notes.title: v1.3 Is Now Available on PC and Mac!
notes.content:
New Marriage Options, a Brand-New Task System, and More!

Coming Soon to Nintendo Switch™

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C6YnufgR9p4

A free content update for Cattails is now available on PC and Mac! If you own the game on Steam, your copy should stay up-to-date automatically. This update will be available on Nintendo Switch™ in Q1 2019, with an expected release window of late January or early February.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29264458/3a827b7764f1da0e99c1bc66a72374ee729aa98d.png

Hailing from the marshes of the Mystic Colony, Krampy is ready to find true love! Don't let the mask (or the leeches!) scare you off, because underneath the mysterious exterior of this veteran doctor lies a caring heart.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29264458/03e503aeddc6448381d249d55320dec3b61a9790.png

A kindly healer from the Forest Colony, Doc is ready to consider settling down. Spend some time with this old cat and you just might find that you've got a lot in common!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29264458/49eedf645fcaf5cdd72aafd58ec09e52676a5c33.png

A timid and shy cat, Luna spends the day taking care of patients in the Mountain Domain. But running a clinic is lonesome work, and perhaps even a cat with such a cold temperament can have a change of heart?

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29264458/affee788bcad4015a3c315e84bcfd3a729508042.png

Galen is a wisened stranger from the distant northern lands. If you are powerful enough to run your very own colony, you may find that this cat will be drawn to a den that's well-stocked with herbs.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29264458/ee5212de8c286b5d0155f0369c8b70511f868c71.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29264458/0776f1db034c222c4b482acc20bcb0a5d21aa14d.png

A new system has been added to Cattails: Tasks! Complete tasks to receive rewards and Task Tokens, which may be exchanged for prizes. Your colony calls on brave cats like you to scout, forage, hunt, explore, and more!

Each day, a new task will appear. You'll have until midnight to complete it. Participating in the tasks is completely optional, but we think you'll be interested in many of the new rewards!

If you've created your own colony, you'll find the Task Board added as a Structure option in the Build Menu.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29264458/7fc63ec0faf597077ff7e93744cc284b421ed2cb.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29264458/41e12fec1e27c36afc9703a67a5a9fabf1d82716.gif

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29264458/ad2a63c5382458192f986337de360033efdbda25.png

Three new Active Skills have been added to the game! You can unlock these powerful new abilities by participating in daily tasks.


 Shield: Become invulnerable to all damage for a few seconds and charge into battle!
 Pinecone Toss: Quickly hurl a pinecone at your enemies for a fast ranged attack!
 Bug Bait: Summon a swarm of in-season bugs around you! (No effect in winter.)


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29264458/557975210d1fd356f45386e693baad0a54ecf1dc.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29264458/71857d039d5787af6f72085b1bf811f346f3a895.png

Looking to save some mews on your next trip to the shop or the clinic? Try befriending the owner!

If you have 5 friendship stars with a shopkeeper, they'll offer you 15% off their items. If you have 5 friendship stars with a doctor, they'll grant a 50% discount on their healing services. It pays to make friends!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29264458/13c8b57f69f1568abe7ba7bb5bfd65731563e91d.png

In addition to these new features, we made a number of smaller changes. Here's the patch notes:


 Added a 'skip tutorial' option if you make a new file on a computer that already has at least 1 other file
 Elli will now allow you to change your kittens' names for 25 mews
 Added some unique wedding dialog pieces for many marriageable cats
 Reduced size of collision box on custom colony dens to allow for more flexible placement options
 7 new coat colors to collect!
 PC/Mac: Added ability to paste text directly into the Promo Code box (ctrl + V)
 Various bug fixes & typo fixes


We hope you'll enjoy the update! You can leave feedback by posting on the official community forums or by emailing us directly at cattailsgame@gmail.com. Until next time...

-Falcon Development

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29264458/376ac52266aee4726c2bf8075fced62a6faafb7b.jpg

notes.title: Cattails Pounces Onto the Nintendo Switch™! (Plus, v1.2, a Technical Update, is available now!)
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29264458/86188ef6ae70d552efc3d931e6554b127c19f693.jpg

Cattails is coming to the Nintendo Switch™ on November 29th, 2018!
Read more at our official press release.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29264458/1083db220cbbf2c04a94554af90392befb49b108.png

Watch the official Cattails Nintendo Switch reveal trailer here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WGHvzpbBzsA

Additionally, today we're announcing what's next for Cattails on PC/Mac!

We've been working hard behind the scenes on two exciting changes to Cattails. The first, a Technical Update (v1.2), is available right now on PC and Mac. While there's not much new in the way of content, we've made a number of important structural changes that will pave the way for the future of Cattails. Here's the v1.2 patch notes:


    4 new colors for your cat are available at various shops
    Overhauled the entire code base to make changes that will make Cattails run much smoother on older machines
    Miscellaneous quality of life and balancing changes
    A host of bug fixes, including a major one regarding random enemy cat spawning. Now enemy territory should feel a bit more dangerous!


Essentially, the biggest change in the Technical Update is that we've "unlocked" the game speed from the computer's computational cycle. What that means is that if you're running Cattails on an older machine (or if you like to place thousands of items on the floor of your den ;) ) you should find that the game runs a lot smoother. This was a fairly involved process that required us to basically go back through each and every line of code in Cattails and make a lot of alterations. Phew, glad that's over with!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29264458/7483403a5c774d0b38fb6efcec6cc85746d6a292.png

Looking ahead to the future, we have a small new content patch scheduled to come out before the end of the year. We think you'll really enjoy what we have in mind! Details coming soon.

It's an exciting time to be a cat! We hope you'll join in our excitement for the Nintendo Switch release, as well as look forward to the PC/Mac updates. Until next time,

-Falcon Development

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29264458/f11bdc05c1ffd184687d9cd44e5112806823f729.png

notes.title: Cattails | Custom Colonies Update is Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello all! Today, March 16, we released the long-awaited and much-anticipated Custom Colonies Update!

Venture deep into the wilderness and find the perfect spot to settle down. Build your den, attract other cats to join you, and customize your capital to make it truly your own. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcx2fo8roXg

Features & Patch Notes:
-----------------------------------------
+Custom Colonies!
	+6 new NPCs, 3 of which are marriageable
	+12 architectural styles to unlock for your colony structures
+14 new coat colors to unlock
+Balance tweaks (especially in regards to store pricing and item availability)
+Various bugfixes & quality-of-life improvements (especially in regards to savefile management)

To start the new content, speak with the Forest Guardian. If you don't have access to the Forest Guardian yet, complete the main quest first.

This update rounds out the very last of the Kickstarter stretch goals, so it's a particularly exciting time for us because it means our vision for Cattails has finally been realized! But don't worry: with so much more to do and so many more ideas still brimming in the back of our minds, we still plan to continue making Cattails an even better experience in the future. More details to come in a later update!

As always, stay awesome!

-Falcon Development
